decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up left-arm approach to the mallet; leave right arm parked. Layout differs, so approach above it before refining grasp.

Continue the rightward mallet orientation and align above the leftmost red key. This orientation should allow all keys without crossing the arms.
Lower the retained mallet vertically onto the leftmost red key, with a small centering correction. Verify contact geometry before lifting and advancing.
